scene_type: 2D (top-down drone view of a swimming pool, camera looking straight down)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels (full 3840x2160 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: near-static (hovering drone). Slow drift relative to frame 0: dx 0 -> about +10..+15 px (max ~+17 near f78) then back to about -4 px at f163; dy 0 -> about +16 px (f100-f140) then +11 px at f163. Content shift sign: + = scene content moves right/down in the image.
camera.per_frame_file: tracks/camera.csv (raw) ; smoothed columns cam_dx_smooth / cam_dy_smooth in tracks/swimmer.csv
camera.magnitude_vs_motion: drift <= ~17 px vs swimmer travel ~1180 px over the clip (about 1.5%); subtract it (use *_camcomp columns) for best accuracy
camera.rotation_zoom: none detected (deck tile joints keep their spacing, wall edge stays horizontal)

perspective: Nadir (straight-down) view: pool wall edge horizontal at y~187, deck tile joints evenly spaced (~134 px) across the full width -> uniform scale, planar assumption valid. Swimmer at water surface; pool floor fixtures ~1-2 m deeper (slightly smaller scale, refraction) - do not mix floor and surface scales unless a question requires it.

objects.name: swimmer
objects.description: the only person: woman swimming breaststroke left -> right along the pool (+x), dark hair, light patterned swimsuit, face covered by a grey privacy-blur patch
objects.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = centroid of the visible body mask (skin + hair + blur patch). Alternatives: trunk_x/y (centroid of eroded mask, torso/hips), head_hair_x/y (centroid of dark hair blob = head)
objects.motion: moves +x (right) throughout, nearly horizontal (y drifts 918 -> 985, i.e. ~+65 px down over the clip, about 3 degrees). Net displacement f0->f163 (camera-compensated): mask centroid ~+1188 px, head (hair) ~+1179 px. Average ~7.3 px/frame; surging speed within each stroke cycle.

size_px.head_to_toe_length_along_x: median 658 px over all frames (p10 588, p90 710; legs bend during kick). In streamlined glide frames: f29 686, f60 708, f123 ~716-730 (checked by eye: toes x~1715, top of head x~2445), f138 698. Best stretched-body length ~700-730 px.
size_px.fingertip_to_toe_length_arms_forward: glide frames f29 948, f82 928, f123 962 (eye check: toes 1715 -> fingertips 2685 = 970), f162 884 px
size_px.width_across_body_arms_wide: bbox height at arm-sweep frames f0 702, f43 704, f95 518, f138 504 px

objects.name: pool_light_far_left
objects.description: round pale-cyan fixture on the pool floor, left, partly under splash

objects.name: pool_light_middle
objects.description: round pale-cyan fixture on the pool floor, middle; swimmer passes over it (~f35-f135 often hidden)

objects.name: pool_light_right
objects.description: round pale-cyan fixture on the pool floor, right; always visible
objects.spacing_note: light_middle -> light_right distance ~1064 px; far_left -> middle ~1490 px

objects.name: pool_wall_top_edge / deck (coping)
objects.description: grey stone deck along the top of the frame with white vertical tile joints; water edge (wall) at y~187 (frame 0), horizontal across the full width
objects.deck_tile_joint_spacing_px: mean 133.9 px (28 joints from x=163 to x=3779; individual spacings 126-139)

objects.name: bottom_shadow_band_and_far_wall
objects.description: dark shaded water band along the bottom (edge wavy, y~1840-1900) and the opposite wall / coping at y~2085-2100 (partly out of frame), with strong sun glints around x 2100-3000
objects.position_px_f0: shadow edge y~1880; far wall edge y~2090
objects.pool_width_visible_px: ~1900 px between top wall edge (187) and bottom wall edge (~2090) - uncertain which line is the true water/wall boundary at the bottom

objects.name: pool_floor_tiles
objects.description: dark green mosaic tiles on the pool floor, rectangular tiles, seen through rippling water

events.event: swimmer already moving at first frame (no start of motion in clip)
arms swept wide (out-sweep / pull, bbox height max)
arms fully extended forward (glide, bbox length max)
head forward-surge maxima (local max of head x-velocity)

events.value: ~46-48 frames (~2.1 s) between successive arm sweeps / glides

events.event: swimmer still moving at last frame; no turn, no wall contact
